name: AutoTrust Decider Pro Vision 27B (JEV-27B-VL)

lineage.how_derived: LoRA adapter (base_model_relation adapter) trained on a distilled decision corpus (SargeDev/jev-distill-corpus-v3); the unmodified base serves as 'System 2' for thinking

purpose: One decision model instead of a ranking team: calibrated typed decisions (choice, yes/no, score) for recommendation, search re-ranking and similar, in about half a second; the card also reports embodied-reasoning results (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Apache License 2.0 text read in the repo LICENSE file: commercial use, modification and redistribution allowed with notice and patent grant.

architecture.kind: hybrid Gated-DeltaNet plus full attention dense transformer (Qwen3.8-27B layout)
architecture.attention: full attention every 4th layer, hidden 5120, head dim 256

variants.format: safetensors BF16 (adapter plus weights, 56 GB in the repo)

pc-12gb.notes: 56.05 GB file exceeds the 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget

pc-16gb.notes: 56.05 GB file against 13.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; part of the dense weights stream from RAM (decode is bandwidth bound)

pc-24gb.notes: 56.05 GB file against 21.6 GB VRAM plus 82 GB RAM budget; part of the dense weights stream from RAM (decode is bandwidth bound)

pc-32gb.notes: 56.05 GB file against 29.6 GB VRAM plus 82 GB RAM budget; part of the dense weights stream from RAM (decode is bandwidth bound)

mac-16-24gb.notes: 56.05 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 56.05 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 56.05 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

benchmarks.name: ERQA (embodied reasoning QA, 400 questions)
benchmarks.variant: with thinking (medium); 53.8 in one pass; 95% interval about +-5 points

weaknesses: the ERQA claim ('top open model, tied with Claude Opus 5') is the vendor's; no robot data was used per the card
soft.maturity: 991k downloads and 5.8k likes; the card carries promotional demo banners; why the download count is that far above comparable repos is not explained

tona_fit.reason: A Qwen3.8-27B LoRA for typed decisions and ranking, not a general or coding model; the large download count (991k) comes with no evidence of broader utility.

open_questions: why the downloads are so high (usage by a benchmark or pipeline is a guess, unchecked)
